properties.description: I've always wondered what the inside of vending machine looks like
My first bowl of Ramen in Japan
This ramen had 3 cuts of meet (chicken breast,  pork shoulder and beef) and 2 wonton dumplings.
This petshop had a vending machine specially for buying birthday cakes for dogs.
Cold udon breakfast at the airport
Hachiya Ramen, a pungent anchovy-based soup topped with black garlic oil.
Genghis Kahn - grilled lamb.  Apparently named so because the grill looks like a mongol hat
There always seem to be far more of these girlie bars in small Japanese cities than the local economy should reasonably be able to support
Cafe I stopped off in to warm up after trudging through now for 2 hours
Please do not stub your massive novelty-sized cigarette in this childs face.
Otaru - once Hokkaido's main port,  now a popular tourist destination
My ferry to niigata. The waves were 5m high!
There was no wifi - just this TV playing Colombo poorly dubbed into Japanese
The public bath on the boat.  It had an open-air section!
My tiny cabin.  No door just a pull-down blind
I ended up chatting with the locals in this Izakaya. They were bemused as to why I was "sightseeing" in Niigata.
They really know how to do drain covers here
This shinkansen had broken down and there were literally 5 news helicopers circling overhead and a crowd of people taking photos
Sapporo ramen - Miso,  butter and sweetcorn
Octoberfest (held in May for some reason)
Introducing my housemates to European culture
I like this shot from the train, even if it is a little blurry
View from the ski-jump of Sapporo city
The mongolian entry to the ice sculpture competition
Overdid the saturation on this one
I like this shot of the birds
I reaaally overdid the saturation in some of these early photos
A lot of the houses were abandoned and collapsing on the outskirts of this resort - Hokkaido is one of the fastest depopulating regions of Japan
Wonderful memory of the american tourist next to us pointing at what was very clearly steam and loudly asking "Is that smoke or condensation honey?"
Many many pictures of cool rocks with trees on them
An other cool rock although I got carried away with the telephoto here
I believe this was a wedding shoot
The local temple up the road
The path into the mountain forest.  I was warned of feral monkeys
Nice shot,  shame about the bag in the corner!
Couldn't see Mt Fuji in July
"Bonsai village",  a district outside Omiya station.  Lots of cool trees but no photos allowed inside this shop :(
You could just about see Rishiri-fuji from the cape
In June and July,  the hills are meant to be full of wildflowers - unfortunately I just missed it
I missed the bus and got stuck at this cape for 3 hours
Near the halfway point of the 8-hour hiking route
These construction workers fixing the seawall gave me a lift in their all-terrain-vehicle down the mountain
